claimByGuilds checks _msgSender() ownership of the derivative token
tokenId parameter is used to derive the forged token id and ownership check
contractAddress parameter selects the guild details and external NFT contract
claimByGuilds writes the elected Conqueror when the guild cap is reached
claimByGuilds increments counterGuild per mint
claimByGuilds mints the forged token via _safeMint

claimByPatrons delegates minting to reservedMinting

claimByOGLooters delegates minting to reservedMinting

claimByConquerors delegates minting to reservedMinting
onlyOwner claimByOwner mints reserved owner tokens
claimByOwner updates the owner placeholder details via processing
onlyOwner activateClaims sets blockActivation with a delay
withdraw performs a value transfer to the treasurer after updating the lock flag
treasurer.current is the destination of the balance transfer
withdraw releases the treasurer lock by setting canChangeTreasurer to true
owner-supplied newAddress becomes the new treasurer
owner-supplied lockTreasurer decides the treasurer lock state
onlyOwner setTreasurer rewrites the treasurer struct
onlyOwner setTreasurer may lock further treasurer changes
addresses parameter is iterated to register guilds

whitelisted guilds get a verified Traveler entry

percentage parameter drives the price division and adjustment
isPositive parameter decides adding or subtracting the price delta
processing mutates priceForPatrons with percentage-based math

block.timestamp seeds the pseudo-random color generation
reservedMinting calls processing for bookkeeping

_safeMint triggers _checkOnERC721Received before returning

_msgSender() is forwarded as operator to the receiver callback
pluck uses msg.sender as part of the randomness seed

normalization_plan.reason: tokenId is only meaningful as the ownership-checked input of claimByGuilds
contractAddress is only used to select the guild and its external NFT contract inside claimByGuilds
newAddress exists solely to be written into the treasurer struct by setTreasurer
lockTreasurer only toggles the canChangeTreasurer flag inside setTreasurer
addresses is only iterated to extend whiteListedGuilds within addNewGuildToWhiteList
percentage only parameterizes the price arithmetic of processing
isPositive only selects the direction of the price arithmetic in processing
adjusted is a transient id computation consumed by claim/claimByOwner minting
rand is a transient keccak-derived value used only inside pickAColor
